svg.title: How drainscope splits one window of battery energy between consumers

g.aria-label: One window on battery: where 6.6 W went
Illustrative numbers. Each window is at least 10 s, so the battery’s slow readings line up with the processor’s.
RAPL: processor, graphics and memory, measured
Above the floor: shared by CPU and GPU time
